method: One warmup batch per arm, then five independent batches per arm, alternating measurement order. Reported mean and p95 are across each arm's per-operation batch times. Output equality, including stable first-200 callers and seeds_cut, is asserted before timing.
scope: Synthetic caller IDs after the proven/likely, nonempty, non-target filter; measures only seed deduplication. This does not measure report construction, SQL, graph traversal, tests_at, or end-to-end edit_check.
input_note: 2,000 and 5,000 are stress cardinalities, not source caps. RESOLVER_ROW_CAP=5,000 caps only identifier resolver evidence in Accounting::claims; load_rows and report.sites have no matching cap.
